scope.added_behavior: Optional canonical expected SID is compared with the current process primary-token SID before registry backend construction and before any key access. Dry runs validate syntax without token or registry access.

original_evidence.note: Original x86 fixtures support the retained preference HKCU/HKLM storage and reset paths; they do not establish an original SID guard or interactive-user preference behavior. The separate pinned-original SESU lazy/culture matrix does not establish preference-wrapper parity.
